stories.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
stories.take: Amazon and Meta are reportedly talking about ending a two-month blockade of Muse — a thaw that would put Meta's agent back in front of Amazon shoppers.

stories.title: Todoist confirms 6% of customers’ details were stolen in data breach
stories.take: Todoist says a hacker reached its production systems and took email addresses, password hashes and account dates for 6% of customers — worth a password check today.

stories.title: Guilty: Huawei faces steep penalties for stealing T-Mobile, Cisco trade secrets
stories.take: A US jury found Huawei guilty of stealing T-Mobile and Cisco trade secrets and evading Iran sanctions; steep penalties now follow.

stories.title: AI is straining America’s open records systems
stories.take: AI-generated requests are swamping small-town open-records offices — Panton, Vermont's one-person clerk operation is the case study.

stories.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
stories.take: Anthropic closed below its IPO price, a post-IPO slump that could cool valuations across AI startups.

stories.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
stories.take: A new benchmark finds even top AI agents fail at reliable, safe everyday tasks — the personal-assistant gap is still real.

stories.title: Geico unites brand icons in holiday ad mixing human craft, nostalgia
stories.take: Geico gathers its brand icons in a first-of-its-kind holiday ad, leaning on handcrafted creative and nostalgia as AI fatigue grows.

stories.title: Brands turn to handmade craft, handfuls of creators for holiday season
stories.take: Coca-Cola, Walmart and Levi's are betting holiday shoppers want the real thing — handmade craft and real creators over AI-generated ads.

stories.title: The Aflac Duck Finally Meets Its Match in Ben Affleck
stories.take: Aflac pairs its duck with Ben Affleck in a cinematic spot from Artists Equity, Affleck and Matt Damon's production company.

stories.title: AI Agent Traffic to Surge 150x This Cyber Week, Driven Mostly by Meta Muse
stories.take: Agent-led site traffic is forecast to surge 150x this Cyber Week, driven mostly by Meta's Muse — shopping discovery is moving to agents.

stories.title: Why brands are writing no-AI clauses into creator deals
stories.take: Brands are writing no-AI clauses into creator contracts; creators welcome them, but both sides must define banned AI use up front.

stories.title: Crystal Palace tried to get away with posting AI and fans tore it to shreds
stories.take: Crystal Palace posted AI imagery of its own stadium and fans tore it apart — 'imagine not having a photo of your own stadium.'

stories.title: Lakers latest in NBA to establish prediction market partnership
stories.take: The Lakers signed a Kalshi prediction-market partnership, following the 76ers and the league itself — prediction markets are now standard NBA business.

stories.title: Vocal Green swats back at online critics, fuels Warriors' victory over Celtics
stories.take: Draymond Green answered online critics on social media, then closed out Golden State's 88-87 win over Boston with a late defensive stop.

stories.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the 'fun' of weathering the storm
stories.take: With Oklahoma City's core decimated by injuries, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is carrying a burden unlike any he has faced — and calling it fun.

stories.title: NBA, amid push for Europe league, launches $11B arena initiative
stories.take: The NBA's Europe league took another step with a plan targeting nearly $11 billion in arena funding.

stories.title: NBA Rookie Rankings: Which stars are rising early in season?
stories.take: ESPN's first rookie rankings put 10 early standouts from a strong 2026 draft class in order — a month in, the class looks deep.

stories.title: Tarik Skubal gives players 450 million more reasons to fight salary cap
stories.take: Skubal's record deal is the union's best exhibit against a salary cap: the free market just paid the game's best pitcher what he is worth.

stories.title: Sources: Cubs continue spending spree, add 2-time Japanese MVP Sato for $120M
stories.take: The Cubs' spending spree continues: two-time Japanese MVP Teruaki Sato signs for six years and $120 million.

stories.title: Sources: Peralta stays in AL East, gets $125M deal to top Orioles rotation
stories.take: Freddy Peralta lands a five-year, $125 million deal to top Baltimore's rotation, staying in the AL East.

stories.title: Free agent Bohm reaches 2-year deal with Royals, reports say
stories.take: Free agent third baseman Alec Bohm has a two-year deal with Kansas City, per multiple reports.

stories.title: MLB drops escrow provision in salary cap proposal as talks take holiday hiatus
stories.take: MLB dropped its escrow demand in its salary-cap proposal as CBA talks pause for the holiday — one obstacle down, the cap fight remains.

stories.title: US army calls Iowa lead detonation a ‘huge success’ and says threat of spontaneous explosions has been ‘eliminated’ – live
stories.take: The Army detonated 68 barrels — nearly 9,500 lbs — of degrading lead azide in Iowa and called it a 'huge success'; health questions over the plume remain.

stories.title: Trump proposing new tariffs on 14 partners including China and EU
stories.take: Trump is proposing new tariffs on 14 partners, including an added 20% on Chinese imports that would bring China's total to about 40%.

stories.title: Kilmar Ábrego García, target of Trump’s immigration crackdown, lands in Spain after ‘leaving happy’
stories.take: Kilmar Ábrego García has left the US for Spain, choosing to depart after his wrongful deportation to El Salvador became the crackdown's defining case.

stories.title: Thousands of immigrants with legal status lose Medicaid coverage
stories.take: Hundreds of thousands of immigrants living legally in the US recently lost Medicaid under a provision of Trump's tax and spending law.

stories.title: World has six consecutive days 2C above preindustrial levels for first time
stories.take: Daily global temperature hit 2.24C above preindustrial levels on Monday — a six-day streak above 2C for the first time on record.

stories.title: Visualized: how Democrats swept downballot races and tipped the balance of power in the US
stories.take: The Guardian's visuals show the scale of the midterm sweep: Democrats won one-third of Republican-held downballot statewide posts.

stories.title: Here's where king tides pose biggest risk in SoCal; evacuation warnings multiply across state
stories.take: Evacuation warnings multiplied across the coast Wednesday as king tides — possibly the biggest in four decades — threaten flooding from San Francisco to San Diego.

stories.title: LAPD shot at more people last year than any other major U.S. police agency, new reports say
stories.take: Two new reports say LAPD officers opened fire more times in 2025 than police in New York, Chicago or any other large US city.

stories.title: L.A. has ADU fever: Accessory dwelling units make up 41% of new housing permits
stories.take: ADUs made up 41% of LA's new housing permits last year — 7,439 units, more than the next 17 cities combined.

stories.title: Does Gavin Newsom have any regrets? He’s not saying as he looks to 2028
stories.take: Winding down as governor and eyeing 2028, Newsom defended his record at the Sacramento Press Club — and would not name a regret.

stories.title: The research center that stands to gain $4 billion from a ballot initiative doesn’t have a CEO
stories.take: One research institute stands to receive $4.2 billion from voter-approved Proposition 38 — and it currently has no CEO and only one qualifying institute exists in the state.

stories.title: After explosion of toxic trash, residents demand extension of temporary housing
stories.take: Families who fled the Chiquita Canyon landfill's toxic trash eruption want temporary housing extended past Thanksgiving; LA County has declared a local emergency.

stories.title: Yahoo CEO Jim Lanzone on AI, Search, & the Fight to Stay Relevant
stories.take: Lanzone calls Yahoo the 'white whale of turnarounds': after shedding TechCrunch, AOL and ad tech, Yahoo still touches 90% of US internet users monthly, with Mail #2 to Gmail and top-three US search • Its new Scout engine is explicitly not a chatbot — lightweight Anthropic and Gemini models over 30 years of Yahoo data, linking out to sources • Yahoo has agent work in labs but does not yet let outside agents like Muse connect to Yahoo Mail

stories.title: Huawei has been found guilty of bank fraud in the US
stories.take: Huawei was found guilty on 10 of 12 charges — conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank fraud over hidden Iran dealings — but acquitted of racketeering; sentencing is expected next September • Colombia's supermarket hostage standoff continued, with about 30 people held in Cartagena • Senegal were reinstated as Africa Cup of Nations winners by the Court of Arbitration for Sport, overturning CAF

stories.title: US announces new tariffs on China and other countries
stories.take: The US announced tariffs on 13 countries plus the EU over 'structural excess capacity': China up to 40%, Vietnam 35%, with the EU, India and Japan also targeted; Canada is not on the list • Leaked Rosstat data analysed by the BBC confirm at least 490,000 Russian soldiers killed since 2022, with estimates up to 700,000 • Colombia police freed about 20 supermarket hostages after 17 hours; South Africa's Ramaphosa won his Phala Phala court battle

stories.title: Anthropic’s IPO Is Already Underwater
stories.take: Anthropic priced at $83, popped above $110 on IPO day, then closed below $83 on day four, down 6.5% • Guest George Noble calls the IPO 'probably overpriced' — decelerating growth, negative cash flow, hundreds of billions in compute commitments, and 300M+ shares already sellable with 3B+ more next month • Noble argues a failed Anthropic IPO is a domino risk for OpenAI, Oracle, Microsoft and Amazon, and calls AI 'the greatest misallocation of capital in history'

stories.title: Democrats’ New Climate Strategy? Deregulation.
stories.take: Yes — Senate Democrats led by Sheldon Whitehouse and Martin Heinrich are backing the bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act, a permitting overhaul scaling back 1970s environmental laws to build energy projects faster • The bet: cutting red tape speeds clean energy more than fossil fuels because renewables win on cost once barriers fall; the bill passed the Senate with nearly every Republican and 15 Democrats • Opponents warn it could unleash fossil-fuel projects under Trump that are hard to undo; SunZia, the wind project that took nearly two decades to permit and three years to build, is the exhibit

stories.title: Sorry, even store brands are expensive now
stories.take: 'Cheapflation': in the US from Jan 2020 to May 2024, cheaper food and drink prices rose 30% while premium versions rose 22% — in Italy cheap rose almost 30% vs 15% premium • Two drivers: shoppers trading down push cheap prices up, and low-margin cheap products pass cost rises through faster, including tariffs • It hits low-income shoppers hardest and may have erased COVID-era gains; canned corn that was 33 cents is now close to $1, even store brand

stories.title: Another round of 'king tides,' Local emergency at Chiquita Canyon Landfill, Ski season arrives  — Morning Edition
stories.take: Another round of king tides hits the SoCal coast today, with water levels possibly above six feet; Sunset Beach crews built sand berms, and Newport and Seal Beach are preparing for flooding • LA County supervisors declared a local emergency at Chiquita Canyon Landfill a week after its eruption; the fire chief told residents, 'if there's a smell, there's something in the air' • Today is the last day to cure ballots in LA and Orange counties; Big Bear and Mountain High open ski season this week

stories.title: Big Tech is ready to spend even bigger to win in 2028
stories.take: Molly White: about 40 AI data-center ballot measures were shot down in the midterms, and AI super PACs backfired — tens of millions spent in NY-12 made AI itself the issue • Crypto spent $64 million in Ohio to oppose Sherrod Brown after spending $40 million in 2024 — and Brown won this time; most races where crypto spent, its candidates lost • Both AI and crypto PACs say they will spend very heavily in 2028, using the 'back the winner' tactic to look like kingmakers

stories.title: Army Explosives Detonation In Iowa, Abrego Garcia Leaves The US, Congress And Nvidia
stories.take: The Army planned to detonate thousands of pounds of crystallised, unstable lead azide in Iowa after evacuating a five-mile radius; experts criticised the late public notice and warn there is no safe level of lead exposure, especially for kids • Kilmar Abrego Garcia voluntarily left the US and arrived in Madrid, Spain, a free man, per Sen. Chris Van Hollen • Congress is pressing the FBI and CIA on what they knew about Nvidia chief Jensen Huang before questioning him

stories.title: Is Medicare for All Within Reach?
stories.take: No — not in its true form: no filibuster-proof majority, Trump in office for two years, and insurers and pharma opposed; Washington has not come close to a government-run replacement for private coverage • What may be within reach is incremental: lowering Medicare eligibility to 55, covering all children, and adding dental, vision and hearing — still the biggest reform since the ACA • One route discussed: pitch it to Trump as 'Trump Care,' after he reposted the idea; also, Anthropic closed below its $83 IPO price
